engineering.meaning: 四种共有原生工具执行回执成功率的成对差异
engineering.raw_formula: 成功执行回执 / 执行尝试；重试另计，未知保留
engineering.weight_basis: Fixed before real runs; equal=50. Rate mapping is percentage-point difference; low-is-good share mapping is relative resource use. Task quality is shown separately.
engineering.limitations: Pooled attempts have differing tool mixes. Per-tool counts/rates are mandatory diagnostics; this is not intrinsic reliability under matched tool exposure.

engineering.meaning: 所有角色模型请求完整流及usage回执的成对差异
engineering.raw_formula: HTTP200且完整DONE及有效usage的请求 / 已派发HTTP请求
engineering.weight_basis: Fixed before real runs; equal=50. Rate mapping is percentage-point difference; low-is-good share mapping is relative resource use. Task quality is shown separately.

engineering.meaning: 同任务、同模型与价格版本的全角色USD估算费用
engineering.raw_formula: 全部确认结算的请求费用之和；未知预留不补零
engineering.weight_basis: Fixed before real runs; equal=50. Rate mapping is percentage-point difference; low-is-good share mapping is relative resource use. Task quality is shown separately.
engineering.limitations: Low cost or short failed runs do not demonstrate equal-quality efficiency; original outcome and termination reason must be read alongside.
